language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the app and by the AI assistant.
language.label: Language

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password used to sign in. This will sign you out on all other devices.

jsonImportExport.title: JSON import/export
jsonImportExport.description: Show the options to import a recipe from JSON-LD and to export a recipe as JSON in the app's menus.
jsonImportExport.label: Enable JSON import/export

family.title: Family
family.description: Everyone in your family shares one recipe collection — all recipes, tags and categories are visible to every member, and any member can edit them.
family.inviteHint: Anyone who opens this link and signs in joins your family. Only share it with your household.
family.leaveDialogDescription: The shared recipes stay with the family — you will start again with an empty collection of your own.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently delete your account and your settings. Recipes, tags and categories your family shares stay with the family; if you are its only member, they are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.checkEmailBody: If that email is registered, we've sent a link to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.invalidLinkBody: This reset link is missing its token. Request a new one.

list.empty: No recipes yet. Try importing or adding one.

recipeForm.detailsDescription: The basics — title, description, and photo.
recipeForm.timingDescription: How long this takes to make, and how many it serves.
recipeForm.categoryTagsDescription: Help this recipe surface in search and filters.
recipeForm.reviewingUrlDraft: Reviewing a recipe imported from a URL — check it carefully before saving.
recipeForm.reviewingAiDraft: Reviewing an AI-generated draft — check it carefully before saving.
recipeForm.addTagPlaceholder: Add a tag and press Enter

importJson.title: Import a recipe
importJson.cardDescription: Copy the recipe's structured data and paste it below.

importUrl.title: Import from URL
importUrl.cardDescription: Point Yumbry at a recipe page and review a draft before saving it.

aiChat.improveDescription: Describe what you'd like to change — the preview always shows the current recipe.
aiChat.createDescription: Describe the dish you'd like to make — a live preview builds as you chat.
aiChat.improveExample: e.g. "make it spicier" or "swap the chicken for tofu".
aiChat.createExample: e.g. "a spicy vegetarian curry, serves 4" — say as much or as little as you like.
aiChat.changePlaceholder: Tell the AI what to change
aiChat.cookPlaceholder: Tell the AI what you'd like to cook

units.label: Units
units.description: Choose the units the AI assistant writes new recipes in. Recipes you have already saved are never converted.

smallVolumes.label: Small amounts
smallVolumes.description: How the AI assistant writes small amounts in metric recipes. Millilitres are exact; spoon measures are quicker to reach for. Has no effect on imperial recipes.

recipePreview.empty: Your recipe will appear here once you start chatting.

joinFamily.title: Join this family
joinFamily.description: You've been invited to share a recipe collection. Your own recipes, tags and categories come with you and are merged into the family's collection.

language.title: Welcome to Yumbry
language.description: Let's set a few things up. First, choose your language.

create.title: Ways to add a recipe
create.description: Pick whichever fits — you can mix and match any time.
create.hint: Find "Add recipe" in the top right of any page. It opens straight into whichever way you'd like to start.

manual.title: Write it manually
manual.description: Type up ingredients and steps yourself, from scratch.

url.title: Import from a URL
url.description: Paste a link and Yumbry pulls in the recipe for you.

ai.title: Generate with AI
ai.description: Describe a dish and let AI draft the recipe.

family.title: Cook together
family.description: When you join a family, everyone's recipes come together into one shared collection.
family.hint: You can create or join a family any time from Settings.

pwa.title: Add Yumbry to your home screen
pwa.description: Install Yumbry like an app so it's one tap away.

iosSafari: Tap the Share icon in Safari's toolbar.
Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
iosOther: Open this page in Safari — other iOS browsers can't install apps to the home screen.
androidOther: Look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen" in your browser's menu.
desktop: Look for an install icon in the address bar (or the browser menu).
Click "Install" to add Yumbry as an app on this device.

done.title: You're all set
done.description: Your kitchen is ready. Start by adding your first recipe.
